set.body: Add a physically parameterized Helmholtz/Sobolev shaper with a Gale matrix-free differential oracle, coarse-to-fine work grids, feature policy ablation, workspace reuse, full optimize/reject loop, receipts, typed diagnostics, and export to image/spatial morphism pairs. The production smoother may be specialized only after oracle and frequency-response tests.
set.title: HalfFlow 5: Sobolev shaping and coarse-to-fine nonlinear engine
